test_title: PYST 06: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Rearrange the parts of this sentence:

(A) before the heavy rains

(B) the villagers

(C) repaired the damaged bridge

(D) with the help of officials
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (3)** i.e. **BCAD**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence begins with the subject "The villagers," which is correctly indicated by **part (B).**
 
• Following the subject, "repaired the damaged bridge" **(BC)** continues the logical sequence, making it clear what the villagers did.
 
• **The next part,** "before the heavy rains," adds information by providing the context of time, indicated by **(A).**
 
• **Ending with** "with the help of officials"** (D) **completes the sentence by showing how the action was completed

Therefore, the correct answer is **BCAD.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (DACB):** This option starts with "with the help of officials the villagers before the heavy rains repaired the damaged bridge," which creates a confusing and grammatically incorrect sequence.
 
• **Option 2 (BACD):** This option starts with "the villagers with the help of officials before the heavy rains repaired the damaged bridge," which disrupts the logical flow of the sentence.
 
• **Option 4 (ABCD):** This option starts with "before the heavy rains the villagers with the help of officials repaired the damaged bridge," which makes the sentence awkward and unclear.
